cues.text: Watch F1 Finance's accounting machine check October's payroll for HANGS Construction against the books and the bank.
First, it reads both payroll registers, the list of every paycheck.
Next, it ties the pay to the books and to the bank withdrawals. Both agree to the cent.
Payroll taxes check out, and both deposits were on time.
One required deduction, just over $300, was withheld but never sent to the state.
One employee who had left was still paid. Another's overtime was paid at the normal rate.
Last, it writes the workpapers and an unsigned memo for the controller, the head of accounting.

All done. October's payroll, about $193,500, ties to the books and the bank. Three exceptions need a person, with three journal entries, corrections worth just over $3,000. Nothing is posted and no payroll is changed until the controller approves.
